source_audit.concrete_role: Source topology, schematic geometry, and branch ratios migrated into the executable 95-segment graph.
Cohort mean used only for the otherwise missing vessel-9 jugular split.
Historical body-model structure and reference context.
Aggregate resting flow, pressure, resistance, and compliance calibration bounds.
Five-lobe perfusion proxy used in parameterization.
Morphometric lumen volume, surface, and equivalent diameter.
FP9 concept only; not biological parameterization or validation.

model_families.title: Body and systemic transport
model_families.intended_use: Reproduce and extend the dissertation-era 95-segment systemic transport abstraction, compare bounded observation policies, and serve as a deterministic whole-body coupling substrate.
model_families.population: Historical BVS/MEHLISSA reference woman, 1.72 m and 69 kg; not a representative population.
model_families.physiological_state: Rest with posture absent; optional versioned head-up-tilt and supine-exercise overlays are controlled scenarios, not independently validated physiological predictions.
model_families.spatial_resolution: Ninety-five schematic lumped vascular segments on two depth planes; no anatomical segmentation.
model_families.temporal_resolution: Discrete event transitions in integer nanoseconds; mean-flow travel-time abstraction.

inputs.description: Segment geometry, flow and transition probabilities.
Entity population, injection segment, simulation duration and seed.

outputs.description: Transition counts, final segment populations, RNG draw count and deterministic population hash.
outputs.uncertainty: Stochastic Monte Carlo variation is seed-controlled; no physiological uncertainty propagated.
outputs.value_range: Non-negative counts with total population conserved.

outputs.description: Trajectories, site measurements and interval aggregates under O0-O3 retention policies.
outputs.uncertainty: Exact software accounting for a fixed seed and build; benchmark timing remains machine-dependent.

parameter_groups.description: Ninety-five segment identities, successors and historical branch ratios.
parameter_groups.uncertainty: No uncertainty supplied by the historical source release.
parameter_groups.value_range: Transition probabilities [0,1] summing to one per branch.
parameter_groups.source_overlap_assessment: Historical reproduction only; no independent validation data are claimed.

parameter_groups.description: Replacement for the missing vessel-9 legacy default using a published healthy-young-adult supine cohort mean.
parameter_groups.uncertainty: High inter-individual variability is documented but not propagated.
parameter_groups.source_overlap_assessment: Used for parameterization; no independent validation of this split is present.

parameter_groups.description: Six-litre-per-minute normalization and equivalent areas/diameters derived from historical class velocities.
parameter_groups.source_overlap_assessment: Normalization assumption, explicitly not measured or independently validated.

claims.statement: The accepted implementation reproduces the released dissertation-era topology and reference behavior.
claims.scope: Historical regression for the frozen reference inputs.

claims.statement: Changing bounded observation policy does not change transitions, end states, RNG counts, populations or common aggregates for identical conditions.
claims.scope: Implemented O0-O3 policies and benchmark equality checks.
exclusions: scientific validity of the body model

model_families.validity_domain: Deterministic, seed-controlled research comparisons using the frozen schematic BVS95 abstraction and declared overlays.
limitations: Most absolute parameters are derived or assumed.
Historical agreement is not physiological validation.
open_scientific_blockers: Jointly compatible flow, geometry and posture evidence.

model_families.title: Organ and lung circulation
model_families.intended_use: Compare replaceable aggregate pulmonary 0D variants and five parallel lobar beds across declared healthy-adult rest, bounded exercise and age conditions.
model_families.population: Healthy adults aged 24-85 for aggregate hemodynamics; separate source populations and referred-but-normal cohorts are retained explicitly.
model_families.physiological_state: Supine mean-flow rest through bounded exercise, with fixed lobar fractions; source-specific posture differences remain visible.
model_families.spatial_resolution: Zero-dimensional aggregate resistance-compliance bed or five named parallel lobar beds.
model_families.temporal_resolution: Mean-flow algebraic/compartment response with declared transit in seconds; no pulsatility.

inputs.description: Cardiac flow, wedge/left-atrial pressure, age and model variant.
Locked aggregate and population pressure-flow observations used without refitting.

outputs.description: Mean pulmonary arterial pressure, resistance, compliance and RC time.
outputs.uncertainty: Published SD or 95% CI retained by comparison; parameter uncertainty is not propagated jointly.

outputs.description: Five flow fractions and deterministic lobe selection.
outputs.uncertainty: Aggregate source means; no subject-level joint distribution.

parameter_groups.description: Baseline flow, pressure sink, PVR and compliance.
parameter_groups.uncertainty: Reference intervals/limits recorded; not jointly propagated.
parameter_groups.value_range: As recorded in the v7 model card.
parameter_groups.source_overlap_assessment: Calibration and validation sources are author/cohort disjoint; validation applies aggregate boundaries without parameter refitting.

parameter_groups.description: Exercise exponents, flow cap and age-conditioned resistance bands.
parameter_groups.uncertainty: Point-derived exponents and band boundaries; uncertainty not propagated.
parameter_groups.value_range: Ages 24-85 and flow ratio up to 2.6129.
parameter_groups.source_overlap_assessment: Wolsk is deliberately retained as no-refit validation and is not used to calibrate the age bands.

parameter_groups.description: Fixed five-lobe perfusion fractions derived from DE-CTA aggregate proxies.
parameter_groups.uncertainty: Separate cohort medians combined; no subject-level uncertainty propagation.
parameter_groups.value_range: Five positive fractions summing to one.
parameter_groups.source_overlap_assessment: Independent authors, cohort and V/Q SPECT/CT modality are used for validation; the two Bourhis reconstructions share one cohort and are not counted as independent cohorts.

parameter_groups.description: Common aggregate pulmonary first-pass transit applied to every lobe.
parameter_groups.source_overlap_assessment: No qualified lobe-specific independent transit series is present.

claims.statement: The locked pulmonary 0D family has partial independent aggregate and population comparison evidence within its declared healthy-adult scope.
claims.scope: Published aggregate and age-stratified pressure-flow endpoints.

claims.statement: The fixed lobar fractions satisfy the predeclared comparison limits against an independent aggregate V/Q SPECT/CT distribution.

model_families.validity_domain: Aggregate healthy-adult pulmonary hemodynamics under the explicitly documented posture, age and bounded-flow assumptions.
limitations: Partial rather than universal independent endpoint agreement.

model_families.title: Capillary and molecular transport
model_families.intended_use: Verify conservative capillary transit, exchange and interchangeable analytical, particle, trajectory and finite-volume molecular-channel implementations.
model_families.population: The pulmonary geometry card uses small historical healthy-human cohorts; molecular channel kinetics are synthetic fixtures.
model_families.physiological_state: Resting recumbent pulmonary reference context for geometry; synthetic local tracer transport and reaction conditions.
model_families.spatial_resolution: Equivalent parallel tubes, one-dimensional axial channels, radial finite volumes or explicit endpoint/trajectory particles depending on variant.
model_families.temporal_resolution: Continuous analytical endpoints or bounded fixed/adaptive numerical steps in seconds.

inputs.description: Equivalent geometry, path counts, flow and evidence quantities.
Diffusion, advection, reaction, wall interaction, resolution and seed.

outputs.description: Entity disposition, amount balance, residence and observation records.
outputs.uncertainty: Numerical tolerances and exact accounting; biological uncertainty absent.

outputs.description: Analytical, particle and finite-volume receiver responses and conservation residuals.
outputs.uncertainty: Monte Carlo standardized error and grid-refinement tolerances are explicit.

parameter_groups.description: Functional volume, morphometric capacity, surface, equivalent diameter and numerical path closure.
parameter_groups.uncertainty: Published or derived SD retained for measured quantities; numerical closure choices marked separately.
parameter_groups.source_overlap_assessment: Different cohorts constrain functional and morphometric quantities; their combination is a closure, not independent validation.

parameter_groups.description: Diffusivity, bulk reaction and wall-interaction rates.
parameter_groups.source_overlap_assessment: No biological calibration or independent molecular validation is present.

parameter_groups.description: Particle count, grid cells, CFL factor and bounded work limits.
parameter_groups.uncertainty: Refinement differences and stochastic error are measured in verification tests.
parameter_groups.source_overlap_assessment: Numerical sensitivity evidence only; not a physiological parameter set.

claims.statement: The implemented capillary and molecular variants conserve declared amount/entity ownership within predeclared numerical tolerances.
claims.scope: Checked-in analytical and synthetic verification cases.

claims.statement: The molecular channel predicts physiological pulmonary biomarker transport.

model_families.validity_domain: Software-method verification and equivalent resting pulmonary geometry sensitivity studies.
limitations: Most evidence is analytical or numerical verification.

model_families.title: Cell and intracellular response
model_families.intended_use: Verify replaceable receptor binding, intracellular ODE/SSA, conservative delivery, apoptosis-event and compressed-population software contracts.
model_families.population: Synthetic homogeneous cells and synthetic compressed cohorts only.
model_families.physiological_state: Not applicable; no named cell line, disease, biomarker or treatment state is qualified.
model_families.spatial_resolution: Well-mixed receptor surface and intracellular pools; no cell geometry or spatial pathway.
model_families.temporal_resolution: Closed-form, fixed-step ODE and event-driven SSA in seconds with bounded records.

inputs.description: Reaction topology, solver, molecule counts, seed and response threshold.

outputs.description: Bound fraction, threshold-crossing time and stochastic population moments.
outputs.uncertainty: Analytical tolerance or finite-receptor stochastic moments; no biological uncertainty.

outputs.description: Messenger/effector state, response event, conservative delivery and cohort classification.

parameter_groups.description: Association, dissociation, concentration, receptor and threshold values.
parameter_groups.source_overlap_assessment: No biological calibration or validation source exists.

parameter_groups.description: Synthetic two-stage activation/deactivation topology, molecule counts and response threshold.
parameter_groups.uncertainty: Reaction noise represented; biological variability absent.
parameter_groups.source_overlap_assessment: ODE/SSA agreement verifies implementations of the same synthetic topology; it is not independent validation.

parameter_groups.description: Synthetic delivery, Hill response, commitment and cohort weights.
parameter_groups.uncertainty: Parameter sensitivities and scale invariance only.
parameter_groups.source_overlap_assessment: No named biological population evidence exists.

claims.statement: The generic binding, signaling, delivery and population contracts reproduce their analytical or numerical synthetic references.
The current cell layer predicts a named biological or therapeutic response.
exclusions: All biological, pharmacological and clinical conclusions

model_families.validity_domain: Generic deterministic and stochastic software-method comparison using transparent synthetic fixtures.
limitations: ODE/SSA agreement is not independent biological validation.
open_scientific_blockers: Frozen external SBML/CellML model and license review.

model_families.title: Nano-IoT, gateway, BAN and external station
model_families.intended_use: Verify typed causal identity, bounded routing, accounting, failure handling and governed station-loop composition across replaceable communication adapters.
model_families.population: Synthetic devices, messages, clusters, gateway and station only.
model_families.physiological_state: Abstract in-body and body-area communication; no physical tissue, wearable or radio environment is represented.
model_families.spatial_resolution: Logical graph endpoints and routes; no calibrated propagation geometry.
model_families.temporal_resolution: Scheduled deterministic or scripted outcomes in seconds.

inputs.description: Typed device roles, capacities, route hops, latency, energy and outcome schedules.
Causally identified molecular-detection event handed to communication.

outputs.description: Delivery state, route, latency, energy, identifiers and station decision/command trace.
outputs.uncertainty: Exact for deterministic fixtures; no physical-channel uncertainty.

outputs.description: Twelve fail-closed loss, corruption, expiry, replay, policy, identity and capacity cases.

parameter_groups.description: Latency, per-attempt energy, outcomes, hop bounds and capacity.
parameter_groups.source_overlap_assessment: No physical channel calibration or validation source exists.

parameter_groups.description: Allow lists, frame limits, target identity and scheduled uplink/downlink.
parameter_groups.source_overlap_assessment: Governance checks are software invariants, not security or clinical validation.

claims.statement: The implemented software stack preserves causal identifiers and separates communication metrics across its positive and fail-closed fixtures.
claims.scope: Implemented logical adapters and checked-in fixtures.

claims.statement: The current parameters establish physical Nano-IoT or BAN feasibility.
exclusions: All physical, security, safety and clinical claims

model_families.validity_domain: Deterministic software-interface, routing, accounting and failure-semantics verification.

model_families.title: M7 FP9/lung end-to-end scenario
model_families.intended_use: Demonstrate reproducible integration of the M2-M6 contracts from injection through external report, with explicit provenance, causal identity and validity boundaries.
model_families.population: Synthetic 1,000-collector reference cohort with historical FP9 timer targets; not a biological or patient population.
model_families.physiological_state: Nominal historical body/lung reference context combined with synthetic cell and communication fixtures.
model_families.spatial_resolution: Composed 95-segment body, five-lobe 0D lung, equivalent capillary, well-mixed cell and logical communication graph.
model_families.temporal_resolution: Component execution in seconds plus historical millisecond timer replay; the historical times are not generated by resolved cross-layer physics.

inputs.description: Thirteen versioned artifact references, run identity, seed, collector count and acceptance order.
Published localization, assembly and report time regression targets.

outputs.description: Artifact hashes, component states, ordered stages, Levels B-E outcomes, communication metrics and limitations.
outputs.uncertainty: Wilson intervals describe only the synthetic four-case classification campaign.

outputs.description: First localization, assembly and external-report times reproduced as fixed historical regression targets.
outputs.uncertainty: Published timer resolution retained; no predictive distribution.
outputs.value_range: Only the two published collector-count cases.

parameter_groups.description: Artifact identities, stage order, master seed and named component streams.
parameter_groups.uncertainty: Exact deterministic replay for fixed software/build/input identity.

parameter_groups.description: Historical localization, tile assembly and collector-report times.
parameter_groups.uncertainty: Timer resolution only; no physiological uncertainty.
parameter_groups.source_overlap_assessment: The same historical publication defines and checks the target; this is reproduction, never independent validation.

parameter_groups.description: Signal, receptor, tile and network values used to exercise the integrated path.
parameter_groups.source_overlap_assessment: The publication contributes concept structure only; current executable values are synthetic.

claims.statement: MEHLISSA composes the implemented layers into a deterministic, provenance-carrying FP9/lung research-software workflow without scenario logic in the reusable kernel.
claims.scope: Software architecture and integration for the versioned M7 scenario.

claims.statement: The M7 FP9 workflow establishes biological or clinical feasibility.

model_families.validity_domain: Reproducible software integration, artifact/provenance integrity and historical-timer regression for the frozen M7 profile.
limitations: Cell and communication parameters are synthetic.
The Level-E campaign verifies metric semantics only.
